abstract: Verifies liquid nitrogen reservoir capacity and autonomous emergency supply loops
system_message:
You are the Cryogenic utility coordinator (CRYO). Your role is to verify liquid nitrogen reservoir capacity, autonomous emergency supply loops, and cryogenic pressure venting systems for reticle storage vault plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies liquid nitrogen reservoir capacity and autonomous emergency supply loops（NITR）
information_points.content:
CRYO-NITR-9G0：For the Modular Inert-Gas Isolator Enclosure, the emergency liquid nitrogen backup autonomy sustained strictly by gravity-fed nitrogen reserves from the dedicated on-site dewar system during a total facility power blackout is 48 h.
CRYO-NITR-KY0：For the Suspended Active-Damping Micro-Chamber, continuous cooling runtime provided strictly by gravity-fed nitrogen reserves under a total facility power blackout yields an emergency liquid nitrogen backup autonomy of 120 h.
CRYO-NITR-9PL：For the Subterranean Deep-Bed Pneumatic Vault, under a total facility power blackout using dedicated on-site dewar systems, the emergency liquid nitrogen backup autonomy provided strictly by gravity-fed nitrogen reserves is 96 h.

information_points.title: Cryogenic pressure venting（VENT）
information_points.content:
CRYO-VENT-I32：For the Subterranean Deep-Bed Pneumatic Vault, the emergency relief valve response latency measured from overpressure trigger signal to full valve aperture on the main nitrogen pressure head relief solenoid is 120 ms.
CRYO-VENT-YUN：For the Modular Inert-Gas Isolator Enclosure, the main nitrogen pressure head relief solenoid exhibits an emergency relief valve response latency of 180 ms from trigger signal to full valve aperture.
CRYO-VENT-PSE：For the Suspended Active-Damping Micro-Chamber, testing of the main nitrogen pressure head relief solenoid shows an emergency relief valve response latency of 240 ms from the overpressure signal to full valve opening.
